table.description: ServiceNow ticket table: incident, change_request, problem or sc_task (catalog task).

record_id.description: Record sys_id (32 hex characters) or record number, for example INC0010001 or CHG0030002.

state.description: Target state as a raw value (for example "2") or a label (for example "In Progress"). Call list_states first to see the valid values.

fields.description: Extra fields the transition needs, for example {"close_code": "<a valid code>", "close_notes": "..."} to resolve an incident, or {"close_code": "successful", "close_notes": "..."} to close a change. The valid close_code values of an incident differ per instance, list them with list_states and field close_code first, because ServiceNow ignores a value that is not one of them and then reports the code as missing.
